methodology.roles: original source role retained; capability presence does not assign primary role; same-path mixed capabilities may still be conditional and do not imply a shared target or guaranteed co-execution
methodology.unit: one troop, final runtime skill prototype
methodology.families: max distinct audit families along one mutually exclusive path; damage includes true/execute as subprofiles; a family is not a balance weight
methodology.branch: presence may be conditional; unconditional means every mutually exclusive path has an eligible segment without segment or ancestor gates; frozen or invalid targets may still prevent actual extra turns or damage
methodology.duplicates: uniqueSpellIds view uses one representative; role/rank tables use troops
methodology.specialMechanisms: native and ST-adapted reported separately; exclude specific scoped bonuses, not all ordinary effects on those units
methodology.costBands: descriptive bins, not new balancing thresholds

damage.executeFormula: target hp for true damage, hp+armor otherwise; ordinary scaling is a placeholder

examples.name: 犀首兽
examples.description: 对 1 名敌人造成 [魔法 + 2] 点溅射伤害。

examples.name: 石巨人
examples.description: 摧毁所有棕色宝石。对一名随机敌人造成 [魔法 + 3] 点伤害，伤害值因被移除的宝石数而增强。 [3:1]

examples.name: 树精
examples.description: 获得 [魔法] 点攻击力和护甲值，并移除所有棕色宝石以增强效果。 [4:1]

examples.name: 黑野兽
examples.description: 吞噬一名盟友。治疗自身并创造 6 颗骷髅头。

examples.name: 阿伯拉瑟
examples.description: 移除所有宝石。恢复所有生命值，并获得 [魔法 + 1] 点攻击力。

examples.name: 幼龙
examples.description: 对 1 名随机敌人造成 [魔法 + 1] 点伤害。转化为一只随机龙族。

examples.name: 万圣小鬼
examples.description: 对所有敌人造成 [魔法 + 9] 点散射伤害，并获得下列其一：将一名随机敌人转化为怨灵，或所有盟友获得 3 点魔力值。

examples.name: 世界毁灭者
examples.description: 爆破 18 颗板面上的宝石。对所有敌人造成 [魔法 + 5] 点伤害。

examples.name: 永生神路西法
examples.description: 爆破 5 颗宝石。消除所有敌人正面增益效果，并对他们造成 [(魔法 x 1.5) + 2] 点真实伤害。若在夏之岛使用，则伤害翻倍。

examples.name: 潘德莫尼亚
examples.description: 对所有敌人造成[(魔法 x 2) + 3]点伤害，骷髅头可提升伤害，并附加诅咒和恐怖效果。有10%的几率获得额外回合，骷髅头可提升额外回合数。 [x2]
